_comment: Positions are in the platform frame: origin at the center of the physical bench/platform TOP SURFACE, Z up, meters. Measure once with a tape measure and a level. Each marker is a printed ArUco tag from the DICT_4X4_50 dictionary (see markers.DEFAULT_DICTIONARY), with a unique id. Two equivalent ways to specify a marker's 3D position are shown below -- use whichever is easier to measure.

0._comment: center/axes form: marker lying flat on the bench surface at its front-left corner, facing +Z (up). x_axis/y_axis span the marker's own plane; need not be unit length, just directions.

1._comment: explicit corners_3d form: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, as the marker is viewed upright. Use this for a marker that's standing upright on a wall/riser rather than flat.
